title: T1190 — Exploit Public-Facing Application
subtitle: An attacker exploits an Internet-facing Exchange-like server.
aria: Animated simulation of a public-facing application exploit: an attacker scans a web server, exploits an SSRF authentication bypass, runs a deserialization payload as SYSTEM, installs a webshell, dumps credentials from the domain controller, and the SOC detects the webshell and the web server spawning a shell.

steps.title: Target selection
steps.caption: The attacker scans IP ranges for exposed Exchange-like servers and picks one with an unpatched version.
steps.defender: inventory your Internet-facing assets continuously - you cannot defend what you have not listed.
